title: Galois descent for quasi-coherent modules on a finite etale surjection
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a surjective finite etale morphism X to Y with a group G acting compatibly, the lemma identifies quasi-coherent modules on Y with systems consisting of a quasi-coherent module on X together with isomorphisms to its pullbacks along the group elements satisfying the cocycle relation (statement lines 2067-2080). The proof reduces the statement to ordinary descent: the morphism is an fpqc covering, the maps from G times X to the double fibre product and from the triple product of G with X to the triple fibre product are isomorphisms, and using those identifications the systems of the lemma are recognized as exactly the descent data for that covering (proof lines 2083-2091). The general fpqc descent theorem for quasi-coherent modules then gives the equivalence (proof lines 2092-2093). The claim is H2: the reduction is a precise but standard translation between two descriptions of the same data, with the identifications written out.
